name: com.baseprojectpackages.core
description: A collection of reusable core systems that any Unity project can build on. It provides an event bus, a state machine, scene loading, input, object pooling, noise, raycasting, screenshots and priority based cursor and timescale control, plus a menu framework and tooltips. Audio and the in-game debug menu live in Base Audio and Base Core Debug, so a project that wants neither does not install them. Everything lives under the Base.CorePackage namespace and ships with matching editor tooling.
